title: Inner product under a product distribution
statement: Let $bbr$ be a real inner-product space and let $V$ be a finite nonempty set with probability mass function $bpi$. For functions $f,g:V^n\tobbr$, their product-distribution inner product is the expectation of $\langle f(x),g(x)\rangle$ when the $n$ coordinates of $x$ are sampled independently according to $bpi$.
hypotheses_covered: probability mass function on a finite space
